implementation.name: Channel F (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 10 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 7 vhdl) alongside 3 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Fairchild Channel F, giving machine_id channelf. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/ChannelF_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/ChannelF_MiSTer/blob/master/channel_f.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 10 source files (1 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 7 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
